d: Can explosive young hitters translate their fearless game into the 50-over arena? Cricket greats Sunil Gavaskar, Ajay Jadeja, Venkatesh Prasad, Maninder Singh, Vivek Razdan, and Anjum Chopra decode Team India’s lineup for the DP World Asia Cup Rising Stars. From Tilak Varma leading from the front to Abhishek Sharma, Vaibhav Suryavanshi, and Harshit Rana in focus, catch all the tactical breakdowns on Extraaa Innings.
